_comment: Concept alignment for the knowledge graph. `merge` = true synonyms: every variant folds onto the FIRST entry (canonical) before node ids form; matching is casefold. `align` = related but deliberately DISTINCT concepts: an aligned_with edge is added between existing nodes, never a merge (e.g. 語音合成 is the TTS task; 語音生成 is the broader family incl. sound/music — keep them separate but connected). Extend freely; `graph build` validates the shape.
